# Vendored assets

## Chart.js

- File: `chart.umd.min.js`
- Version: 4.4.7
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.7/dist/chart.umd.min.js
- License: MIT (https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/blob/master/LICENSE.md)

The bundle is committed so the dashboard works offline, without a build step
and without third-party requests from the browser.
